name: Thermic Ranch
kurzbeschreibung:
**Therme Ranch in Höfen**

Discover relaxation and adventure in the heart of **Tirol** at the **Therme Ranch in Höfen**. Nestled in the picturesque **Inntal**, this unique wellness retreat combines the soothing power of thermal baths with the thrill of ranch life.

Indulge in our **Thermenlandschaft** with thermal pools, saunas, and relaxation areas, all designed to melt away stress and rejuvenate your body. Afterward, experience the authentic charm of a **Tiroler** ranch—feed the animals, enjoy fresh mountain air, and savor traditional dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn** or hearty **Gröstl** by the fireplace.

Whether you're seeking tranquility or outdoor excitement, the **Therme Ranch in Höfen** offers the perfect blend of wellness and adventure in one of **Tirol**’s most beautiful regions.
